description: Zcash transaction check by txid from our own Zebra node: confirmations, block height and time, whether it is in the active chain, size, and how much of it is transparent versus shielded. When to use: did this ZEC payment land, how deep is it, and does it involve shielded inputs/outputs. Do not use: to learn shielded amounts or parties - shielded values are hidden by the protocol and only a viewing key held by a party to the transaction can read them; this tool reports the shielded *shape* (spend/output/action counts) and says so explicitly rather than guessing. Returns: found, confirmations, block_height, block_hash, block_time, in_active_chain, size_bytes, transparent{inputs, outputs, total_output_zec}, shielded{sapling_spends, sapling_outputs, orchard_actions}, has_shielded_component, not_disclosed_by_protocol[].
name: zec_get_transaction
title: Zec Get Transaction
